summary: You show four consented before and after results and WhatsApp, but two phone numbers, two addresses and mixed review counts create doubt.

findings.problem: Two phone numbers appear (+971 50 129 3791 and +971 55 363 7914), the 050 number is labelled LANDLINE, and two addresses are given (Villa 823 Umm Suqeim 3 and 351 Al Wasl Road).
findings.cost: Patients are unsure which number and which location is real.
findings.fix: One number, one address and a map.

findings.problem: The menu items MEDICAL, AESTHETICS, SURGICAL and More link to #. Book Your Consultation goes to #book and Explore Treatments to #services, and no booking form is visible.
findings.cost: Buttons with no clear target lose patients who are ready to book.
findings.fix: Working menus and a short booking form.

findings.problem: The page says 243+ Patient Reviews and also based on 55 Google reviews, and many blank review containers show before the testimonials.
findings.cost: Conflicting counts and empty boxes weaken your strongest proof.
findings.fix: One accurate review count and a clean review wall.

findings.problem: Typos include WhatsAppp and Appoinment, the clinic name appears as Glamorous Aesthetic Clinic, Glamorous Aesthetics and Glam Clinic, and Dr. Elhaam in the menu differs from Dr. Ilham El Arrouchi.
findings.cost: Small errors and changing names look careless.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one consistent name.

redesign: One phone, one address and a booking form on every page.
A clean review wall, consistent doctor names and working menus.
